sync: v1.0.1 — no icon prefix in descriptions, upgrade guide in README

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed router and onboarding guide for the AI KEY skill family, with expected local routing behavior and no evidence of hidden exfiltration or destructive actions.

dimensions.detail: The included script is read-only and scoped to aikey-prefixed skills under common skill directories or the repository, but it prints resolved local source paths, which is more local-environment detail than a simple static router would need.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains manual upgrade/install examples using unpinned npx commands and global skill add/remove options; they are not auto-executed by the skill, but users should review them before running.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses broad natural-language triggers and performs dynamic discovery of installed aikey-prefixed skills, then reads selected skills' SKILL.md files and direct references; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but users should know it may activate on generic help or content-creation requests.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This entry skill says onboarding mode does not collect personal information or write files, while shared family instructions for downstream skills disclose configured vault output and memory writes; no background service, privilege escalation, or hidden persistence was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to route users among AI KEY content and business skills, generate a prompt for the selected downstream skill, and stop; the main instructions repeatedly constrain the skill to routing/onboarding rather than doing full diagnosis, writing, or publishing itself.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an AI KEY family router that can inspect locally installed aikey-prefixed skills and read selected skill instructions to prepare prompts. Review any npx upgrade commands before running them, and expect downstream AI KEY skills to use configured vault files and memory if you invoke them.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Verified: scripts/list-skills.sh scans ~/.claude/skills, ~/.agents/skills, then the repo for aikey-prefixed skills, extracts names/descriptions, and prints resolved paths. This supports dynamic routing and is read-only, but path disclosure is worth user awareness.
[SQP-1] expected: Verified: the trigger list includes broad phrases such as short-video and onboarding/help requests. These match the skill's routing purpose, though ambiguous activation is possible.
[AE1] expected: Verified: the instruction to fully read a selected skill and its direct references is part of generating an accurate downstream prompt and does not itself execute that downstream business workflow.
[RP1] expected: Verified: unpinned npx examples appear in manual migration/install guidance only. This creates normal supply-chain caution for commands the user chooses to run, not automatic remote code execution by the skill.
[SQP-3] expected: Verified: the cited Chinese-language and source-selection guidance is part of a Chinese content-production workflow. It is a style/content preference issue rather than evidence of malicious behavior.
